name: taketori-island-refuge
reviewNotes: All 25 original glyph records reviewed. Keep separate catastrophe stages: cliffs rising, sea turning red, land sinking, Kaguya's capture/death and refugee arrivals.
Preserve the west-of-Taketori Yomi Tower/Rashomon clue and the meteorite falling at the lunar 豐饒村 that can breathe life into a sword; the latter source line was enlarged and checked.
Keep duplicate records 0/1, Urashima's rebuilding response, the floating festival drum and all original hero-name/newline positions. No event logic or quest state is changed.
